description: Returns whether a retailer publishes a policy of matching a competitor's lower price, with the verified terms, exclusions, how to claim, a sentence quoted from the policy and the policy page. answer is yes (a person has verified the published policy), no (a person looked and found none) or unknown (not verified). Whether a particular competitor price qualifies depends on the terms returned.

competitor_price.description: The lower price the shopper has found, in the retailer's currency. Optional; echoed back with the terms.

product.description: What the shopper wants to buy. Optional.

retailer.description: Retailer name, domain or Registry slug, e.g. 'JB Hi-Fi', 'jbhifi.com.au' or 'jbhifi'

name: will_price_match
title: Will this retailer price match?
